| ℹ️  | CI status isn't available to the bot, so "CI is green" is only the author's word |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to add the self-review checklist, then hand it off with "integration review" once CI is confirmed green.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @asyntai, the squashed commit and the avatar fix look good. Could you add the self-review checklist to the PR description, as described in the [reviewable PRs guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html)? Then we'll take another look.
```
